video_title: Jaden McDaniels gets told by fan about Julius Randle trade to Nets

quotes.summary_phrase: Julius Randle traded to the Brooklyn Nets
quotes.excerpt: You see Julius Randle? Just got traded. Brooklyn.

text_blocks.text: You see Julius Randle? You see Julius Randle? Just got traded. Brooklyn.

text_blocks.speaker: Jaden McDaniels
text_blocks.text: For real? That's crazy. Crazy, right? Had to say something, man.

quotes.summary_phrase: Timberwolves trade Julius Randle to the Brooklyn Nets
quotes.excerpt: the Timberwolves sent Julius Randle and pick 28 to the Brooklyn Nets for pick number 33
quotes.quote: For those that missed the full trade details, the Timberwolves sent Julius Randle and pick 28 to the Brooklyn Nets for pick number 33, getting off Julius Randle's contract. The Nets also traded Nick Claxton to the Chicago Bulls.

quotes.summary_phrase: Nets re-sign Onyeka Okongwu to a five-year contract
quotes.excerpt: they were able to re-sign Onyeka Okongwu to a five-year 112 million dollar contract
quotes.quote: Getting off Julius Randle's contract, they were able to re-sign Onyeka Okongwu to a five-year 112 million dollar contract to return to the team.

quotes.summary_phrase: Lakers relieved as Nets trade Julius Randle
quotes.excerpt: you can feel a bit relieved with the Nets getting Julius Randle's contract
quotes.quote: As for the Lakers, you can feel a bit relieved with the Nets getting Julius Randle's contract because that means the Nets are no longer in the Austin Reaves sweepstakes.

quotes.summary_phrase: Giannis Antetokounmpo wanted trade to Minnesota Timberwolves
quotes.excerpt: he also told the Bucks that he would sign a long-term contract if he was traded
quotes.quote: Another trade that you would have seen went down today, Giannis to the Heat. He also told the Bucks that he would sign a long-term contract if he was traded to the Minnesota Timberwolves because he likes the idea of being paired up with Anthony Edwards.
